facts.fact: The ministers of Digital Economy and of Justice launched on 10 February 2026 two portals letting citizens request criminal records and nationality certificates online and track applications.
The article says the criminal record and nationality portals were developed by the digital ministry and AGETIC, the government's information technology agency, with the Ministry of Justice.
Portals developed by AGETIC and the digital ministry with no contractor named were launched on 10 February 2026.

MLI.note: Public-facing certificate portals only; nothing on station records.
